m01.title: The Earth Was Corrupt
m01.desc: The LORD looks upon the earth, and sees what men do.

m02.title: Make Thee an Ark
m02.desc: God tells Noah to build an ark of gopher wood.

steps.axe: Take the axe by the woodpile
steps.chop: Fell gopher trees in the forest ({n}/{total})
steps.carry: Bring the logs to the ark

m03.title: Come into the Ark
m03.desc: In seven days the rain will come. Bring in your house, food and the animals.

steps.family: Day {day} of 7 · Call your family, one by one ({n}/{total})
steps.food: Day {day} of 7 · Gather the food with your family ({n}/{total})
steps.ark: Day {day} of 7 · Lead your family into the ark
steps.animals: Day {day} of 7 · Bring the animals to the ark

m04.title: The Flood
m04.desc: Forty days and forty nights of rain.

m05.title: The Raven
m05.desc: Noah opens the window of the ark and sends forth a raven.

m06.title: The Dove
m06.desc: Noah sends forth a dove, to see if the waters are gone.

m07.title: The Olive Leaf
m07.desc: Seven days later, the dove flies again.

steps.olive: Find the olive tree on the hilltop
steps.back: Bring the olive leaf to the ark

m08.title: The Altar
m08.desc: Noah goes out of the ark and builds an altar to the LORD.

steps.altar: Build an altar to the LORD

m09.title: The Bow in the Cloud
m09.desc: God makes a covenant with Noah and every living creature.

steps.sons: Tell your sons about the covenant ({n}/{total})

m10.title: The Vineyard
m10.desc: Noah becomes a farmer and plants a vineyard.

m11.title: The Garment
m11.desc: Ham sees his father. Shem and Japheth cover him.

steps.cover: Walk backward to the tent and cover your father

sons.text: And Noah was five hundred years old: and Noah begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

giants.text: There were giants in the earth in those days.

wicked.text: And GOD saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.

grieved.text: And it repented the LORD that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him at his heart.

corrupt.text: The earth also was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.

grace.text: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD.

just.text: Noah was a just man and perfect in his generations, and Noah walked with God.

built.text: So Noah and his sons built the ark of gopher wood, with rooms in it, and pitched it within and without with pitch.

did.text: Thus did Noah; according to all that God commanded him, so did he.

enter.text: And Noah went in, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him, into the ark, because of the waters of the flood.

shut.text: And the LORD shut him in.

fountains.text: The same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened. And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.

died.text: All in whose nostrils was the breath of life, of all that was in the dry land, died.

lifted.text: And the waters increased, and bare up the ark, and it was lift up above the earth.

remained.text: And Noah only remained alive, and they that were with him in the ark.

prevailed.text: And the waters prevailed upon the earth an hundred and fifty days.

remembered.text: And God remembered Noah, and every living thing… and God made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters asswaged.

rested.text: And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.

window.text: Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made: and he sent forth a raven.

dove.text: Also he sent forth a dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground.

no-rest.text: But the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot, and she returned unto him into the ark.

again.text: And he stayed yet other seven days; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark.

olive.text: And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth was an olive leaf pluckt off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.

not-again.text: And he stayed yet other seven days; and sent forth the dove; which returned not again unto him any more.

dry.text: And Noah removed the covering of the ark, and looked, and, behold, the face of the ground was dry.

altar.text: And Noah builded an altar unto the LORD; and took of every clean beast, and of every clean fowl, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.

savour.text: And the LORD smelled a sweet savour.

seedtime.text: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.

bow.text: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.

scattered.text: These are the three sons of Noah: and of them was the whole earth overspread.

husbandman.text: And Noah began to be an husbandman, and he planted a vineyard.

drunk.text: And he drank of the wine, and was drunken; and he was uncovered within his tent.

covered.text: And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it upon both their shoulders, and went backward, and covered their father; and their faces were backward.

years.text: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years. And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years: and he died.

generations.t: Many generations after Adam, people filled the earth, and their hearts turned to evil.

sin-violence.t: No one says no to me.

sin-harass.t: Where are you going? Stay with me.

sin-lies.t: Two sacks of wheat for your goat. A fair trade, I swear it.

repent.t: I will wipe man whom I have created from the face of the earth.

make-ark.t: Noah, the earth is filled with violence. Make an ark of gopher wood.
I will bring a flood on the earth. But with you I will establish my covenant.

mock.t: A boat? On a hill? Ha!
Turn from your ways. The LORD sees everything.

come-in.t: Come into the ark, you and all your house: I have seen you righteous before me.
Take seven pairs of every clean beast and fowl, and one pair of the unclean.
And take food for you and for them. In seven days I will send rain.

too-late.t: Seven days passed, and not all were in the ark. Try again.

gather-food.t: Now the food, for us and for every beast. Help me carry it.

to-ark.t: That's all of it. Come, into the ark!

call-shem.t: I'm coming, father. The LORD has spoken.

call-ham.t: Already? The sky is clear… Fine, fine.

lion.t: One pair of the unclean, the LORD said. Come, lion. Gently.

raven-lost.t: The raven went to and fro, and did not come back to the ark.

call-back.t: Come back, little dove! There is no land yet.

go-forth.t: Go out of the ark, you, your wife, your sons and their wives.
Bring out every living thing with you, that they may fill the earth.

blessed.t: Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the earth.

covenant.t: I make my covenant with you: never again will a flood destroy the earth.

remember.t: When the bow is in the cloud, I will look on it and remember my covenant.

tell-shem.t: Shem, see the bow? It is the LORD's promise.
Blessed be the LORD. I will remember it.

tell-ham.t: Ham, no flood will ever destroy the earth again.
Good. I've had enough water for a lifetime.

tell-japheth.t: Japheth, the bow is God's sign. Be fruitful and fill the earth.
So many colours! I'll tell my children about it.

ham-saw.t: Father is drunk… and uncovered! Wait until my brothers hear this.

ham-tells.t: Come and see our father! He lies drunk and naked in his tent!
We will not look at our father's shame.
Take the garment. We'll walk in backward.

awoke.t: I know what you did, Ham. Cursed be Canaan, your son: a servant of servants shall he be to his brothers.
Blessed be the LORD God of Shem. God shall enlarge Japheth.

animals-in.t: Seven pairs of the clean beasts went in, and one pair of the unclean.

after: The LORD kept us through the water. Never forget it, son.
Every time it rains, look for the bow in the cloud.

before: Noah walks with God. People laugh at him, but I don't.
An ark? Here? If the LORD says so, then build it, husband.
Be careful in the city. It's not safe anymore.
days: Seven days… Hurry, Noah, call the boys!
Don't forget the food. The animals will be hungry.
after: Dry ground! I thought I'd never walk on grass again.
So quiet after all that rain.

before: Father says the LORD spoke to him. I believe him.
Gopher wood is strong. Fell it near the forest paths.
days: Seven pairs of the clean animals, father. I'll count them with you.
after: Blessed be the LORD, who kept us alive.

before: A boat on dry land. The neighbours think we're mad.
I'll help… after I rest a little.
days: Is it really going to rain? Not one cloud.
after: One hundred and fifty days of water. I never want to see a fish again.

before: I want to see the animals come! Even the lion!
Two by two, father says. How will they all fit?
days: The deer are in the meadows to the south-east.
after: The whole world is new. Where shall we go first?

before: My father-in-law prays every morning. The others only shout.
days: I'll carry what I can. We need grain for many days.
after: The sky is so clean. Like the first morning.

before: The city frightens me. Men there do whatever they want.
days: Where is Ham? Have you seen him?
after: We were eight in the ark. Only eight.

before: The neighbours stole our goat last week. Nobody did anything.
days: Hay for the animals is out in the meadows.
after: Look, the olive trees are growing again!

before: Rain? What's rain, old man?
Build your boat. We'll laugh from the hill.
Everyone lies. I'm just better at it.
Preaching again? Nobody's listening, Noah.
days: Go on, get in your box. We'll be at the feast.

before: Mind your business, stranger.
In this city the strong take what they want.
days: Eat, drink, marry. Tomorrow is like today.

before: Nobody here helps anybody.
Don't trust anyone in this city.
days: They say old Noah built a giant boat. Strange man.

before: I am a mighty man of renown. Bow down, little one.
Who will stop me? Nobody.
What are you looking at? I found it.
A loaf here, a purse there. Who's counting?
days: Everyone's busy laughing at Noah. Good for business.

before: Up before the sun to bake, and they take it like it's theirs.
No one in this city lifts a finger for another.
days: Bread for a boat? Ha. Who would buy bread on a boat?

before: I owe the giant. Everyone owes the giant.
Please, I have nothing left.
days: They say the old man's God is kind. Is that true?

before: Sand! He sold me sand for my good goat.
You can't trust a soul in this city.
days: Fine weather for the fields. Rain? What nonsense.

before: Where's the sea, old man? Ha!
A boat on dry land. Now I've seen everything.
days: Still at it, Noah? You'll be building till you die!

toasts.spirit: You are the Spirit of the LORD. Look upon the earth.
toasts.axe: Strike a gopher tree to fell it.

complete.body: By faith Noah prepared an ark to the saving of his house (Hebrews 11:7). And the bow in the cloud still tells of God's promise.
complete.next: Next on the path: the Tower of Babel.
